posts.title: Stop apps tracking your every move

slides.text:
Stop apps tracking your every move
Settings > Privacy > Location services
Deny location for apps that don't need it
Revoke camera and mic access you don't use
You keep your data — apps still work the same.
Save this — you'll need it next time.
